cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask Dad if he's seen the flight bill. I need his first reaction before I explain the upgrades.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with a question, not an exhibit. Find out whether he's upset about the total.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if he asks who chose the seats?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's when you fetch me. Don't guess at a justification; just get the question exactly right.

relationship.evidence: B2 proposes a straightforward way to show the bill and B4 wants a boundary on responsibility. A gives a usable boundary in response.

heightening.evidence: B4's possibility makes A5 commit to entering at a defined point, a revealing concession within the cautious-testing Drive.
